scope: All 23 original search-result links represented by the supplied screenshot; bounded relevant sections, primary abstracts/methods and API guidance, not reproduction of all studies.

sources.title: Tessa news
sources.decision: Record encoding, decoding, basis/shot overhead and reconstruction errors separately; no Tessa implementation or memory advantage claimed.

sources.title: IBM workload usage
sources.decision: Implement explicit provider usage status; do not equate scheduling time or estimates with actual billing or money.

sources.title: Trusted quantum computation
sources.decision: Retain validation assumptions and domain. Structured hard-circuit certificates do not transfer to this search solver.

sources.title: Assessing QML advantage, dated PDF
sources.decision: Separate scaling, prediction quality and total-resource comparisons. This review is not independent experimental data.

sources.title: Monitor or cancel a job
sources.decision: Preserve original job IDs, distinguish client timeout from provider cancellation, and fetch usage on noncompletion without resubmission.

sources.title: Legacy IBM Cloud cost page
sources.decision: Use current usage guidance instead; do not treat a redirect as a verified pricing quote.

sources.title: Legacy workload usage URL
sources.decision: Same underlying source as S02, not independent corroboration.

sources.title: IBM and Algorithmiq announcement
sources.decision: Noise manipulation and observable validation are workload-specific. Research-only; no new material simulator or certified mitigation.

sources.title: Quantum Advantage Tracker
sources.decision: Preserve dated strongest baselines and reopen comparisons when they improve; no tracker submission performed.

sources.title: Recent quantum runtime disadvantages
sources.decision: Implement a repeatable direct-classical comparison and total wall accounting. Do not infer unbounded conclusions from the paper cases.

sources.title: Dry-run jobs
sources.decision: Cloud mock output is not simulation or physical measurement. Document separate plan/access requirements; do not introduce automatic cloud submissions.

sources.title: Dawn of quantum advantage
sources.decision: Validation and comparative useful performance remain separate requirements. Forecasts are not this package results.

sources.title: Maximum execution time
sources.decision: Keep provider QPU-usage cap separate from client wait timeout. Preserve actual usage after noncompletion.

sources.title: Runtime disadvantages v2 mirror
sources.decision: The supplied older mirror was unavailable. Use current primary paper, noting revision changes; do not count as independent support.

sources.title: QML route correction
sources.decision: Adopt the task-level baseline lesson; a classical classifier need not simulate the quantum circuit. No genomics/QML claim added.

sources.title: Assessing QML advantage, plain URL
sources.decision: Duplicate underlying PDF, accessed through S04; not another study.

sources.title: IBM REST jobs
sources.decision: Use the existing reviewed SDK path rather than invent REST calls. Preserve unknown/estimated/conflicting usage fields.

sources.title: Quantum advantage framework v1 PDF
sources.decision: Adopt scoped correctness and comparative efficiency requirements; no mathematical certificate supplied for arbitrary practical tasks.

sources.title: IBM advantage news
sources.decision: Trace the shared vendor/paper origin; do not treat syndicated reporting as independent confirmation or package capability.

sources.title: BlueQubit prize report
sources.decision: Peaked-circuit challenge is not generic password or encryption cracking. No wallet interaction, challenge execution or arbitrary key search added.

sources.title: Quantum LLM adapters news
sources.decision: Cayley-adapter preprint has different task, data and hardware requirements. Research-only; Workbench Assistant remains rule-based.

sources.title: IBM twelve-month forecast
sources.decision: Preserve November 2025 forecast as historical. No forecast, trading example or vendor ROI estimate becomes measured package benefit.

sources.title: Nighthawk r2 report
sources.decision: Hardware throughput claims do not imply application latency or speedup. Existing named-backend validation remains required; no unsupported device profile invented.

dependence: Redirects, duplicate PDFs, vendor announcements and derivative news are not independent evidence.
